rising.description: Open-source, local-first social media research agent for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Jev routes read-only steps; socai CLI captures cited browser evidence.

Produces cited evidence and example reports
Documented install and onboarding steps

Relies on an external OpenRouter LLM provider for decisions
Promotional claims such as '#1 Tool of the Day' carry no technical weight

rising.description: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.

strengths: Clear pipeline with named scripts and data sources
Installs across several AI coding agents
Shows reasoning and evidence overlays
risks: Reverse image search relies on browser automation
Geolocating people's photos could raise privacy concerns

rising.description: OSINT tool for username search, email lookup and phone intelligence. 7,900+ lookup modules standardised from 19 projects, with enriched results, evidence graphs and MCP integration. By the OSINT Experts Society.

strengths: Broad module coverage standardised from 19 projects
Multiple install paths including PyPI and Windows bundle
Supports MCP integration and report generation
risks: Person lookup across many sites raises privacy and misuse concerns
Module count claims differ between description (7,900+) and README (9,700+)
Relies on third-party site rules that may break over time

rising.description: Wireshark for the radio spectrum: channelize a wide span once, decode every signal in it at once
rising.summary: Wireshark-style RF tool using SDR hardware to channelize wide spectrum and decode many signal types at once, including ISM devices, aircraft, AIS, APRS, pagers, DMR, TETRA, LoRa and SSTV, with recording and a transcription option.
strengths: Decodes many radio protocols from one wide-band capture
Clear table of supported bands and decoders
Published installers for major platforms
risks: Interception of pager and DMR/TETRA voice traffic raises legal concerns, and TETRA decryption and key recovery is listed
Recording and transcribing over-the-air speech may have privacy implications
Installation and transmit capabilities need legal caution

rising.description: Free alternative to https://osint-ui.com
rising.summary: Free browser-based OSINT toolkit with about 20 tools: Google dork generator, username and email analyzers, breach checks via XposedOrNot and HIBP Pwned Passwords, and domain/certificate lookups via crt.sh, rdap and Shodan InternetDB.
strengths: Clear list of named free data sources and credits
Browser-first design keeps analysed files on the device
Explicit passive-only and responsible-use stance
risks: Username and email lookups on private individuals warrant responsible-use care
Source-available license with Commons Clause limits commercial use
Telegram OSINT component adds account-related sensitivity

rising.description: Who's being heard, not just who's talking. Public social posts of candidates in the 2026 Czech municipal elections across ten cities, collected with Apify into a DuckDB evidence graph and mapped in a static app.
rising.summary: Starwatch collects public social media posts from verified 2026 Czech municipal election candidates via Apify into a DuckDB graph, then displays reach, posts and 2022 results in a static map app.
strengths: Documented pipeline from official registry to static app
Explicit attribution verification and links back to sources
Clear legal note on excluding polls and forecasts
risks: Profiling of named political candidates' social accounts
Snapshot-based, tied to a single hackathon period

rising.description: Watchdog (branding subject to change) is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) case management platform for small teams.
rising.summary: Open-source case management platform for small OSINT teams. Lookups from Caps produce evidence and proposals that a person must accept before entering a shared case graph, with exports regenerated from it.
strengths: Human-in-the-loop acceptance of machine output supports defensible provenance
Clear architecture stack documented with badges and CI
risks: Pre-1.0 and explicitly not hardened for production or multi-tenant use
Capability list and specific data sources are not detailed in the excerpt

rising.description: Strażnik — nieoficjalne wczesne ostrzeganie o zagrożeniach powietrznych dla Polski. Fuzja sygnałów NEPTUN, mediów, RCB, ADS-B i PAŻP + aplikacja Android.
rising.summary: Unofficial early-warning system for Poland fusing NEPTUN, media, RCB, ADS-B and PAŻP air-threat signals into a map and Android app with alerts. Backend runs on FastAPI with MapLibre frontend.
strengths: Fuses several public air-threat sources into one map
Detailed release notes and user manual with screenshots
Android app with alert tuning and Wear OS support
risks: Alert-focused rather than investigative OSINT; safety-critical reliance on unofficial data
Documentation mostly in Polish release notes; README digest truncated

rising.description: CRS-01 — Cannabis Research Sentinel. Graph-first intelligence layer for cannabis breeding knowledge: evidence-backed strain lineage with honest trust tiers.
rising.summary: CRS-01 is a research tool that searches multiple web providers and archive.org for cannabis strain parent-lineage evidence, merges findings into a SQLite knowledge graph with provenance, and derives trust tiers from source agreement. It includes a FastAPI backend and Next.js fron
strengths: Clear provenance and trust-tier model
Documented architecture and write boundaries
Setup instructions and stated limits
risks: Subject matter is cannabis cultivar data, not classic OSINT targets
LLM-based extraction may introduce errors

rising.description: Local-first privacy toolkit. Map yourself against 400+ data brokers, send CCPA/GDPR deletion mail, and check password dumps — the vault never leaves your PC.
rising.summary: Local-first Go CLI for self-privacy: matches your own identity against a catalog of 400+ people-search and marketing brokers, drafts CCPA/GDPR deletion emails, and checks passwords against the Pwned Passwords range API.
strengths: Keeps the vault local with no account required
Uses k-anonymity range queries for password checks
Clear documented default workflow and build steps
risks: Broker catalog maintenance and accuracy unverified
Copies of deletion-request emails sent from user mailbox; limited legal detail in digest
Browser automation and CAPTCHA solver present but off by default

rising.description: Real-time tactical OSINT & GEOINT dashboard. Live flight tracking (ADS-B), maritime vessels, satellites, undersea telecom cables & HUD shaders powered by free, keyless open APIs.
rising.summary: A React/TypeScript dashboard on Leaflet and MapLibre that shows live ADS-B aircraft, AIS vessels, satellites, public cameras, earthquakes, radio streams and undersea cables using free keyless public data sources.
strengths: Documents concrete keyless data sources with endpoints and providers
Runnable quick start with build, lint and typecheck scripts
risks: Camera wall aggregates public traffic cameras, which could be misused for surveillance of locations
Warship and curated datasets are static and not live-verified

rising.description: Export the complete follower list of any public X (Twitter) account to CSV + JSONL.
rising.summary: Python CLI that uses the user's own X session cookies to call X's internal GraphQL API and export an account's full follower list to CSV and JSONL, with resume checkpoints and multi-session rotation.
strengths: Clear usage examples and flag reference
Documents resume checkpoints and output format
Explains how to refresh queryIds when X changes them
risks: Relies on personal session cookies and violates X terms of service, as the README admits
Scrapes an undocumented internal API that breaks when X rotates identifiers
Bulk follower harvesting can enable profiling of individuals

rising.description: Check simultaneously if a phone number is registered on popular apps & websites, without any prerequisite 📞
rising.summary: Go CLI and TUI that checks in parallel whether a phone number is registered on several apps and websites, with JSON output, privacy-conscious logging, and a single-target design.
strengths: Concurrent checks across modules with CLI and interactive modes
Documents silent-by-default behaviour and privacy-conscious logging
Prebuilt binaries and clear usage examples
risks: Phone number registration checks can enable targeting of private individuals
Browser fingerprint evasion features suggest anti-blocking intent
Legal section present but usage is left to the user

Clear feature list with investigation data management
Tests and CI workflow documented

Binary release targets Windows x64 only
Limited detail on usage examples

Offline selftest and clear install steps

Local GUI and CLI with documented sources

Structured output with permalinks and dates for verification
Includes a demo run and documented limits

risks: Username search across 76 platforms enables profile aggregation on individuals
Beta release; availability varies by source
Interface currently Russian-only in the screenshot

identity-lookup.description: See where a username exists across 15 public sites - honest OSINT, zero dependencies, one file
identity-lookup.summary: Python CLI with zero dependencies that checks a username against 15 hand-verified public sites by HTTP status code, reporting found, free, or unclear, with JSON output and a site list.
strengths: Clear method: HTTP 200 versus 404 with unclear results never guessed
Documents excluded sites and the reasons for exclusion
Zero dependencies, single file, with a test badge
risks: Status-code checks can give false results when sites change behavior, which the README acknowledges
Username enumeration across sites can be used for doxxing or deanonymisation

identity-lookup.description: Recherche et corrélation de pseudonymes sur ~3200 sites, avec score explicable et graphe de relations. Autohébergé, sources publiques uniquement.
identity-lookup.summary: Self-hosted web app that searches a username across about 3200 sites, correlates found accounts to a single person, enriches via public APIs, and shows results as a relationship graph with an explainable score. Includes a strong legal-use framework and audit logging.
strengths: Explainable scoring and relationship graph
Self-hosted with Docker Compose and 255 tests
Documents legal framework, GDPR and audit logging
risks: Correlating accounts to a person on username alone can produce misidentification
Personal data of third parties collected without consent
Mentions Stripe billing if exposed as a service

identity-lookup.description: A Kali Linux-friendly Python CLI for public-only username checks and contact discovery on public websites.
identity-lookup.summary: A Python command-line tool that checks candidate public profile URLs for a username, reads public GitHub metadata via the API, and extracts emails and phone candidates from supplied public websites, producing JSON and HTML reports.
strengths: Clear public-only limits and caveats documented
Concrete install and usage instructions for Kali Linux
Outputs structured reports with integrity digest
risks: Username-based profile checks and contact extraction target individuals
Phone candidates may belong to unrelated third parties
Example username appears to be a specific individual handle

infrastructure-asm.description: An AI-powered intelligence analysis assistant built to support investigations, combining persistent memory with curated knowledge bases derived from my analytical methodology the more investigations it runs, the sharper it gets.
infrastructure-asm.summary: A set of Claude Code skills that pivot from a scam website or downloaded app to extract identifiers (favicon hash, analytics IDs, WHOIS, wallets, TLS/JARM, APK signing certs), cluster related hosts in a shared knowledge base, and produce graphs and reports.
strengths: Concrete pipeline with named data sources and a shared JSON contract
Documents optional dependencies and an OPSEC policy keeping case data out of git
Clear phased workflow with convergence stop condition
risks: Leak/stealer-log corpus searching could touch sensitive data
Heavy reliance on AI agent workflow; maturity unclear

knowledge.description: CRS-01 — Cannabis Research Sentinel. Graph-first intelligence layer for cannabis breeding knowledge: evidence-backed strain lineage with honest trust tiers.
knowledge.summary: CRS-01 is a research tool that searches multiple web providers and archive.org for cannabis strain parent-lineage evidence, merges findings into a SQLite knowledge graph with provenance, and derives trust tiers from source agreement. It includes a FastAPI backend and Next.js fron
strengths: Clear provenance and trust-tier model
Documented architecture and write boundaries
Setup instructions and stated limits
risks: Subject matter is cannabis cultivar data, not classic OSINT targets
LLM-based extraction may introduce errors

knowledge.description: `GitHub` `Markdown` `ADINT` `Research` - ADINT: a field guide to ad-tech surveillance. How advertising data (MAID, RTB bidstream, SDK location) becomes warrantless intelligence.
knowledge.summary: A Markdown field guide and curated roster of ad-tech surveillance: data brokers, RTB bidstream, MAID and SDK location data, government buyers, regulators, and a timeline of reported events with sources and glossary.
strengths: Curated roster of entities and sources with RSS feeds
Clear sourcing and disclaimer about public reporting
risks: Documentation only, no working tool
Content is a static reading list rather than a method for investigation

media-forensics.description: Open-source, cross-platform document discovery & metadata reconnaissance tool  a modern, Windows-free alternative to FOCA.
media-forensics.summary: MetaScout is a cross-platform Python CLI and local web UI that discovers PDF and Office documents on target domains via crawling, sitemaps, and the Wayback Machine, then extracts metadata with ExifTool to report leaked usernames and other data.
strengths: Clear documented install and usage steps for macOS, Linux and Windows
Multiple discovery sources including Wayback Machine and sitemaps
Merged multi-target reporting with CLI, web UI and REST API
risks: Surfaces usernames and personal data from documents, a personal-data exposure concern
Active project with substantial docs but early-stage community signals

media-forensics.description: Detect hidden, residual, and machine-readable content in documents, images, and files.
media-forensics.summary: Local, read-only CLI that finds text hidden under black redaction shapes, hidden spreadsheet data, metadata and other residual content in PDFs, Office and OpenDocument files, with JSON, Markdown and HTML reports. Makes no network requests.
strengths: Clear detector reference with 27 detectors
Read-only, no network requests, documented limits
Working example output shown in README
risks: Dual-use potential for recovering redacted personal data from documents
Single-maintainer project of unknown maturity

media-forensics.description: Análisis de metadatos EXIF del reto BreadCrumbs (OSINT · The Breach · ThePwnLab, plataforma del Bootcamp de Ciberseguridad de The Bridge): reconstrucción con ExifTool de dónde y cuándo se tomaron cinco fotografías a partir de sus coordenadas GPS y marcas de tiempo.
media-forensics.summary: Write-up of a CTF OSINT challenge showing how ExifTool reveals GPS coordinates and timestamps in five photos to reconstruct a route. Mainly a learning example, not a reusable tool.
strengths: Clear step-by-step methodology with commands
Explains limits of metadata reliability
risks: CTF writeup, not a working tool
Educational content from a bootcamp context

situational-awareness.description: Strażnik — nieoficjalne wczesne ostrzeganie o zagrożeniach powietrznych dla Polski. Fuzja sygnałów NEPTUN, mediów, RCB, ADS-B i PAŻP + aplikacja Android.
situational-awareness.summary: Unofficial early-warning system for Poland fusing NEPTUN, media, RCB, ADS-B and PAŻP air-threat signals into a map and Android app with alerts. Backend runs on FastAPI with MapLibre frontend.
strengths: Fuses several public air-threat sources into one map
Detailed release notes and user manual with screenshots
Android app with alert tuning and Wear OS support
risks: Alert-focused rather than investigative OSINT; safety-critical reliance on unofficial data
Documentation mostly in Polish release notes; README digest truncated

situational-awareness.description: Real-time tactical OSINT & GEOINT dashboard. Live flight tracking (ADS-B), maritime vessels, satellites, undersea telecom cables & HUD shaders powered by free, keyless open APIs.
situational-awareness.summary: A React/TypeScript dashboard on Leaflet and MapLibre that shows live ADS-B aircraft, AIS vessels, satellites, public cameras, earthquakes, radio streams and undersea cables using free keyless public data sources.
strengths: Documents concrete keyless data sources with endpoints and providers
Runnable quick start with build, lint and typecheck scripts
risks: Camera wall aggregates public traffic cameras, which could be misused for surveillance of locations
Warship and curated datasets are static and not live-verified

situational-awareness.description: Every public signal of the war in Ukraine on one live map: air threats, alerts, the front line, military air and sea, satellites and forecasts. EDTH London 2026.
situational-awareness.summary: Live map fusing 25+ open streams on the war in Ukraine: Air Force threat reports, alert map, DeepStateMap front line, military ADS-B aircraft, satellites, news, with forecasts and source links.
strengths: Integrates many named open sources into one live map
Links each fact to its source and publishes model scorecards
Has a live demo, 128 tests and a stated open-data-only policy
risks: Event-driven war monitoring may be used for targeting-adjacent purposes
Forecasts of landing sites and danger are model outputs with uncertain accuracy
Hackathon project; long-term maintenance uncertain

situational-awareness.description: OmniScope Web - 100% Serverless Static Geospatial Intelligence & Doppler Weather Radar Dashboard for Cloudflare Pages. Zero cloud database fees, zero server costs, pure open data.
situational-awareness.summary: Serverless static web dashboard for Cloudflare Pages showing live radar precipitation, USGS earthquakes, Open-Meteo weather, public webcams and ISS orbit, with an MCP server and keyless edge APIs.
strengths: Keyless, client-side design using public open data feeds
Named data sources and a documented deployment path
risks: README contains heavy promotional and trademark claims with little technical substance
Weather and webcam focus is only loosely OSINT; limited investigative use

situational-awareness.description: Karnak — a live OSINT situational monitor: a wall of live streams, an AI situation brief, a fused news timeline, market indicators, and a network-reachability watch. Named for Ozymandias's monitor wall in Watchmen.
situational-awareness.summary: Pantau (codename Karnak) is a single-page Docker web dashboard that monitors civic events such as Indonesian protests via live YouTube streams, an LLM situation brief, merged Google News and RSS timeline, volcano alerts, markets, and platform reachability checks.
strengths: Clear setup via Docker Compose and optional API keys
Multiple named public sources and features
Explicit no-tracking and no-login stance
risks: Reachability probing from residential connection may raise legal considerations
Relies on third-party APIs and keys such as TikTok signing service
Project appears early-stage with a placeholder clone URL

situational-awareness.description: Myanmar Dashboard is a locally hosted OSINT and geospatial monitoring platform featuring detailed Myanmar maps, state and regional boundaries, airports, air bases, seaports, conflict references, pipelines, regional news, RSS feeds, public Telegram channels, dark-web onion RSS, ransomware intelligence, earthquake data and 15 intelligence categories.
situational-awareness.summary: A locally hosted dashboard that maps Myanmar with boundaries, airports, seaports and conflict references, and aggregates regional news, GDELT, RSS, public Telegram, dark-web RSS, ransomware and USGS earthquake feeds.
strengths: Clear regional geospatial focus on Myanmar
Lists concrete data sources and a Windows launcher
Documents limitations such as unverified live feeds
risks: Live news retrieval was not verified in the build environment
Several map markers are approximate reference locations
Dark-web RSS access requires Tor and verified sources

social-media.description: Open-source, local-first social media research agent for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Jev routes read-only steps; socai CLI captures cited browser evidence.
social-media.summary: Local-first agent that uses an AI decision model to drive the user's signed-in Chrome via the socai CLI, searching and reading Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn content and producing source-cited research reports.
strengths: Runs locally in the user's own browser with read-only steps
Produces cited evidence and example reports
Documented install and onboarding steps
risks: Automates logged-in social platform accounts, possibly against platform terms
Relies on an external OpenRouter LLM provider for decisions
Promotional claims such as '#1 Tool of the Day' carry no technical weight

social-media.description: Who's being heard, not just who's talking. Public social posts of candidates in the 2026 Czech municipal elections across ten cities, collected with Apify into a DuckDB evidence graph and mapped in a static app.
social-media.summary: Starwatch collects public social media posts from verified 2026 Czech municipal election candidates via Apify into a DuckDB graph, then displays reach, posts and 2022 results in a static map app.
strengths: Documented pipeline from official registry to static app
Explicit attribution verification and links back to sources
Clear legal note on excluding polls and forecasts
risks: Profiling of named political candidates' social accounts
Snapshot-based, tied to a single hackathon period

social-media.description: Export the complete follower list of any public X (Twitter) account to CSV + JSONL.
social-media.summary: Python CLI that uses the user's own X session cookies to call X's internal GraphQL API and export an account's full follower list to CSV and JSONL, with resume checkpoints and multi-session rotation.
strengths: Clear usage examples and flag reference
Documents resume checkpoints and output format
Explains how to refresh queryIds when X changes them
risks: Relies on personal session cookies and violates X terms of service, as the README admits
Scrapes an undocumented internal API that breaks when X rotates identifiers
Bulk follower harvesting can enable profiling of individuals

social-media.summary: Rust CLI and HTTP service that inspects public GitHub profiles, repositories, commit identities and SSH/GPG keys, producing JSON, Markdown, text, SVG or PDF reports with source references and optional GitLeak enrichment.
strengths: Clear modes (FAST/DEEP) with stated bounds
Separates observed data from inferences and notes limits
Documents privacy handling and rate limits
risks: Surfaces personal contact addresses from commit history, a personal-data exposure concern
Optional GitLeak enrichment touches leaked-data sources

social-media.description: Instagram Scraper — free, open-source Instagram scraper. Unlimited profiles, posts, reels, comments and hashtags as clean JSON, no API key, no proxies.
social-media.summary: A free, open-source Instagram scraper exposed as a local API that returns profile, post, reel, comment and hashtag data as JSON, with example outputs and endpoint documentation.
strengths: Working local API with curl example
Clear JSON output examples for profiles
Covers profiles, posts, comments, hashtags and locations
risks: Scraping may violate Instagram terms of service
Promotional wording like unlimited and no proxies with few stated limits
Topics include email scraping, raising personal-data concerns

social-media.description: Scrape Facebook GraphQL data without an API key — profiles, posts, comments, reactions, groups, marketplace, search_engine.

strengths: Clear API examples for profiles, posts, comments and groups
Avoids brittle HTML parsing and headless browsers
risks: Requires logged-in session cookies, risking account exposure and ToS violations
Facebook scraping may break as internal endpoints change
Profile and reactor extraction can enable tracking of individuals

social-media.description: Pure standalone, zero-browser Meta Threads intelligence engine & CLI. Cloud API & SaaS at https://skelepel.id
social-media.summary: Node.js CLI and library that scrapes Meta Threads profiles, timelines, keyword search results and reply trees over HTTP without a browser, with optional local SQLite dataset storage. Also promotes a paid cloud service for lead extraction.
strengths: Clear CLI commands and usage examples
Local SQLite dataset storage with deduplication
No browser dependency, fast HTTP-based collection
risks: Promotes commercial lead extraction service alongside the tool
Scraping a platform may violate its terms of service
Profile and post extraction raises personal data concerns

social-media.description: Instagram OSINT toolkit: Playwright-based harvester for profiles, posts, followers & following, plus ig-analyzer — a live local analysis dashboard with engagement, posting-pattern and bio-intel metrics.
social-media.summary: A Node.js and Playwright tool that drives a logged-in Chrome over CDP to harvest Instagram profiles, posts, comments, followers and media into local files, plus a live local dashboard (ig-analyzer) for engagement and posting-pattern analysis.
strengths: Documents CLI flags, config layering, output formats and an analytics dashboard
Clear disclaimer citing legal compliance and privacy laws
risks: Scrapes Instagram against its Terms of Service using logged-in accounts, with account-ban risk
Bulk follower and comment harvesting of individuals enables profiling without consent

social-media.summary: A Claude Code skill that reads public Telegram channels without an account via t.me/s pages and searches full history; groups require the user's own Telegram account. Returns structured post records with permalinks, dates, links, and reactions.
strengths: Works without account or API key for public channels
Structured output with permalinks and dates for verification
Includes a demo run and documented limits
risks: Group access uses the user's own Telegram account, raising account-use and ToS considerations
Scraping individual channels' full history could be used for monitoring people

social-media.description: 🔮 Early access to the latest ASIMOV Alpha builds for agentic social media intelligence.
social-media.summary: Early-access alpha of ASIMOV, an agent-driven social media intelligence tool that maps social graphs across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Luma and GitHub and can enrich results with local CRM contact data such as Attio.
strengths: Named supported platforms
Runs as a skill inside common AI agents
Installs from release zips for macOS, Windows and Linux
risks: Claims to bypass restrictive APIs, a possible platform terms-of-service concern
Little documentation of data handling or legal limits
Closed-source-looking alpha distribution with binary downloads only

web-capture.description: Offline OSINT triage for saved HTML: link inventories, host summaries, line references and SHA-256 evidence hashes. Zero runtime dependencies.

strengths: Works fully offline with zero runtime dependencies
Clear usage examples and JSON/CSV/Markdown output formats
risks: Narrow scope limited to static HTML link inventories
Early version (0.2.0) with limited community adoption signals

web-capture.description: Ferramenta de dorking em múltiplos motores de busca para coleta de URLs em operações de OSINT e reconhecimento.
web-capture.summary: Python CLI that runs search dorks in parallel across multiple search engines (web, code, pastes, leaks) and returns the union of found URLs, with an embedded dork catalogue and usage examples.
strengths: Clear input modes: free dork, dork file, embedded category catalogue, stdin
Documented usage examples and Docker install options
Parallel querying across many sources
risks: Legal warning about attacking targets without consent is present but brief
Bypass of search engines via browser automation may violate terms of service
Leak-oriented dork categories could be used for exposure hunting

strengths: Concrete features: streaming CDX ingestion, risk tiers, parameter classification
Installation steps are clearly documented
Passive use of public Internet Archive data
risks: Active HEAD requests to live targets during verification
Bug-bounty focus could be misused for reconnaissance of unauthorised targets
Marketing-heavy README with limited legal considerations

web-capture.description: Ferramenta de extração e descoberta de URLs para fluxos de OSINT e reconhecimento
web-capture.summary: Python CLI (SRURL) that takes seed URLs, fetches pages and extracts reachable URLs, with passive and active sources, same-origin spidering, recursive rounds, API-key sources, profiles, and Docker support.
strengths: Clear usage documentation with many flags and examples
Modular source plugin architecture
Docker and profile presets
risks: README is Portuguese-only digest with limited legal notes visible
Active probing with verify=False in example code

Multiple search modes including FQDN, domain and digest lookups
Documented install and configuration steps
risks: Depends on access credentials granted at CIRCL's discretion
Search can be slow with --alltime
README is truncated in places

workspace-analysis.description: Watchdog (branding subject to change) is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) case management platform for small teams.

strengths: Human-in-the-loop acceptance of machine output supports defensible provenance
Clear architecture stack documented with badges and CI
risks: Pre-1.0 and explicitly not hardened for production or multi-tenant use
Capability list and specific data sources are not detailed in the excerpt

workspace-analysis.description: Offline desktop workspace for organizing OSINT investigations.
workspace-analysis.summary: OpenTrace is an offline, privacy-focused PySide6 desktop app for organizing OSINT investigations. It offers a visual investigation board, tasks, verification queue, sources, hypotheses, journal, SHA-256 integrity info, and PNG/JSON export.
strengths: Fully offline with no telemetry or accounts
Clear feature list with investigation data management
Tests and CI workflow documented
risks: Does not itself collect OSINT data; value depends on user workflow
Binary release targets Windows x64 only
Limited detail on usage examples

Investigate sources, challenge hypotheses, analyze artifacts, and produce evidence-referenced reports with portable case files and offline Python tools. Designed for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI.
workspace-analysis.summary: A set of 16 OSINT and forensic skills for AI coding assistants that preserve evidence, track source references and hypotheses, produce EN/FR reports, and export case files, with offline Python tools for reviewing selected artifacts.

Offline Python runtime with standard library only
Covers multiple assistants such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI
risks: Benchmarks do not establish claimed accuracy gains
Breadth of 16 skills may mean shallow coverage of each
Depends on the host assistant's web tools for research
